items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: That must have been before I could play music, but he used to play.

ctx.x: Let me see, Johnny Lindsey? He's thinking of Joe Lindsey, you see.

You think about Joe Lindsey, eh? Oh, yeah, Joe. Johnny Lindsey played trombone, played bass with Robeshoe a long time. I see, John. That must have been before I could play music, but he used to play. No!
He was with Pierron on trombone for years. Tell him he was with Pierron.
